headline: MOMbot reports a closed-loop robot scientist for biological experiments
summary: A bioRxiv preprint describes MOMbot, a five-station laboratory platform combining imaging with chemical, electrical, mechanical and thermal interventions, and reports four biological experiments. Its adaptive-learning demonstration is narrower: in one electrical-stimulation campaign, the authors report 121 organoid interventions and say algorithm-selected durations concentrated nearer an ID50 estimate than uniform sampling. These are author-reported results; no independent reproduction was conducted.
